notes.title: We have updated the English version
notes.notes:
The previous translation has been replaced, and new English version will also be applied to DLC.

We hope you enjoy this game.

notes.title: The English version of Nyakori's Rabbit Doll will be replaced.
notes.notes:
We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the insufficient translation of the game text. There were some issues with the game because we hired a poor translator.

We are planning to replace the translation of Nyakori's Rabbit Doll. The new version is expected to be completed around mid-March.

notes.title: Announcement of release delay
notes.notes:
We are so sorry that because production crew hasn’t controlled the progress well in the early stage, it is impossible for us to bring an optimal experience of the game in 27th January 2020.

After a series of careful consideration, we now decide to delay the release date to 31st January 2020 and promise that the production crew will not make such mistake any more!
